div.head: III As 6
div.ab: Sextum: si aliquis homo sit adeo diues uel tante parentele, ut (cur) castigari non possit uel idem cessare nolit, ut facias (efficias), qualiter abstrahatur in aliam aliquam partem regni tui, sicut dictum est in occiduis partibus, sit alterutrum quod sit sic comitum sic uillanorum.

Sextum, si aliquis homo sit adeo dives vel tantæ parentelæ ut castigari non possit vel idem cessare nolit, ut facias qualiter abstrahatur in aliam aliquam partem regni tui, sicut dictum est in occiduis partibus, sit alterutrum quod sit, sic comitum sic villanorum.

Sixthly, if any man is so rich, or belongs to so powerful a kindred that he cannot be punished, and moreover is not willing to desist [from his wrongdoing], you shall cause him to be removed to another part of your kingdom, as was declared in the west—whatever his station in life, whether he be noble or commoner.
div.note: Latin only; no German translation in Liebermann. Liebermann compares V As Prol. 1.
